title: Polynomial-time padded pair interleaving
statement: For a bit string $z$, take the total first and second projections of $z$, paddedly pair their bits for $|z|+2$ positions by using $0$ whenever either string has ended, and concatenate each resulting pair in order. The function sending $z$ to this bit string is polynomial-time computable.
